2608.04765.title: Explicit Language Memory for Long-Horizon Planning in Vision-Language-Action Models
2608.04765.paper_summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a unified paradigm for connecting visual perception, language understanding, and robotic control. However, existing VLA models still face major challenges in long-horizon tasks: sparse expert demonstrations constrain cross-task compositional generalization; the non-Markovian nature of long-horizon tasks makes it difficult for policies conditioned only on current observations to maintain temporal consistency; limited closed-loop error correction allows execution errors to accumulate; and end-to-end action fine-tuning may weaken the high-level semantic representations of vision-language model (VLM) backbones. To address these issues, we propose a hierarchical long-horizon VLA architecture with an explicit language-memory module. The central idea is to convert discrete temporal observations into a coherent textual memory sequence with temporal logic. The system is decoupled into a high-level VLM and a low-level VLA: the high-level VLM performs semantic reasoning through a visual question answering training paradigm, while the low-level VLA executes precise continuous control conditioned on subtask instructions and visual observations. The high-level VLM recursively updates both language memory and subtask instructions using the previous memory as a contextual anchor, enabling persistent temporal tracking and dynamic correction during long-horizon execution. We evaluate the proposed method in multiple simulation environments and conduct sim-to-real experiments on a real robotic platform. The results demonstrate that explicit language memory improves the success rate and robustness of VLA models on complex long-horizon tasks while providing an interpretable semantic account of the decision process.
2608.04765.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動 (VLA) 模型提供了一個統一的範式，用於連接視覺感知、語言理解和機器人控制。<lb/>然而，現有的 VLA 模型在長期任務中仍面臨重大挑戰：稀疏的專家示範限制了跨任務的組合泛化；長期任務的非馬可夫性質使得僅依賴當前觀察的策略難以保持時間一致性；有限的閉環錯誤修正使執行錯誤得以累積；而端到端的行動微調可能削弱視覺-語言模型 (VLM) 主幹的高層語義表示。<lb/>為了解決這些問題，我們提出了一種具有明確語言記憶模塊的分層長期 VLA 架構。<lb/>核心思想是將離散的時間觀察轉換為具有時間邏輯的連貫文本記憶序列。<lb/>系統被解耦為高層 VLM 和低層 VLA：高層 VLM 通過視覺問答訓練範式執行語義推理，而低層 VLA 則根據子任務指令和視覺觀察執行精確的連續控制。<lb/>高層 VLM 使用先前的記憶作為上下文錨點，遞歸更新語言記憶和子任務指令，從而在長期執行過程中實現持續的時間跟踪和動態修正。<lb/>我們在多個模擬環境中評估所提出的方法，並在真實機器人平台上進行模擬到現實的實驗。<lb/>結果顯示，明確的語言記憶提高了 VLA 模型在複雜長期任務中的成功率和穩健性，同時提供了可解釋的決策過程語義說明。
